# Arena: a 24-sided sand floor (top at z 0) fanned and subdivided so painted rings and darker
# patches are picked as faces; a paved apron ring (its top cut away under the sand) and a rocky
# underside below the rim; a crenellated
# stone wall broken by four gates, each flanked by two round pillars. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 0.7333 0.4980 0.3412 --no-slot
material new Mark --base-color 0.4471 0.3490 0.3373 --no-slot
material new Stone --base-color 0.4471 0.3490 0.3373 --no-slot
material new Pave --base-color 0.2235 0.2235 0.2235 --no-slot
material new Rock --base-color 0.3373 0.1961 0.1490 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Floor --vertices 24 --radius 4.6 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 -0.15
apply --location
material assign Sand
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
subdivide --cuts 9
select face where "normal.z > 0.5 && ((pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y > 9.3025 && pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y < 10.8900) || (pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y > 0.5625 && pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y < 0.9025) || ((pos.x - (-2.591))*(pos.x - (-2.591)) + (pos.y - (0.799))*(pos.y - (0.799)) < 0.1627) || ((pos.x - (-2.512))*(pos.x - (-2.512)) + (pos.y - (0.551))*(pos.y - (0.551)) < 0.1084) || ((pos.x - (1.031))*(pos.x - (1.031)) + (pos.y - (2.368))*(pos.y - (2.368)) < 0.1146) || ((pos.x - (0.388))*(pos.x - (0.388)) + (pos.y - (-1.401))*(pos.y - (-1.401)) < 0.0712) || ((pos.x - (2.851))*(pos.x - (2.851)) + (pos.y - (1.826))*(pos.y - (1.826)) < 0.1243) || ((pos.x - (3.719))*(pos.x - (3.719)) + (pos.y - (1.002))*(pos.y - (1.002)) < 0.1699) || ((pos.x - (-1.625))*(pos.x - (-1.625)) + (pos.y - (-2.356))*(pos.y - (-2.356)) < 0.0551) || ((pos.x - (2.615))*(pos.x - (2.615)) + (pos.y - (0.247))*(pos.y - (0.247)) < 0.0454) || ((pos.x - (0.680))*(pos.x - (0.680)) + (pos.y - (1.724))*(pos.y - (1.724)) < 0.0427) || ((pos.x - (-2.328))*(pos.x - (-2.328)) + (pos.y - (0.537))*(pos.y - (0.537)) < 0.1485) || ((pos.x - (-2.908))*(pos.x - (-2.908)) + (pos.y - (-0.351))*(pos.y - (-0.351)) < 0.0961) || ((pos.x - (-1.273))*(pos.x - (-1.273)) + (pos.y - (-2.076))*(pos.y - (-2.076)) < 0.0682))"
material assign Mark
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Apron --vertices 24 --radius 5.7 --depth 0.4 --location 0 0 -0.2
apply --location
material assign Pave
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
poke
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
subdivide --cuts 3
select face where "normal.z > 0.9 && pos.x*pos.x + pos.y*pos.y < 4.4*4.4"
delete only-faces
mode object
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 12 --radius1 5.6 --radius2 0.8 --depth 3.0 --location 0 0 -1.9 --rotation 180 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Rock
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select vert where "pos.z < 1.2"
randomize --amount 0.25 --seed 5
mode object
add mesh cube --name W0 --size 1 --location 4.832 -0.423 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -5.00
add mesh cube --name W1 --size 1 --location 4.685 -1.255 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -15.00
add mesh cube --name W2 --size 1 --location 4.396 -2.050 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -25.00
add mesh cube --name W6 --size 1 --location 2.050 -4.396 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -65.00
add mesh cube --name W7 --size 1 --location 1.255 -4.685 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -75.00
add mesh cube --name W8 --size 1 --location 0.423 -4.832 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -85.00
add mesh cube --name W9 --size 1 --location -0.423 -4.832 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -95.00
add mesh cube --name W10 --size 1 --location -1.255 -4.685 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -105.00
add mesh cube --name W11 --size 1 --location -2.050 -4.396 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -115.00
add mesh cube --name W15 --size 1 --location -4.396 -2.050 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -155.00
add mesh cube --name W16 --size 1 --location -4.685 -1.255 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -165.00
add mesh cube --name W17 --size 1 --location -4.832 -0.423 0.375

set rotation 0 0 -175.00

scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -185.00
add mesh cube --name W19 --size 1 --location -4.685 1.255 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -195.00
add mesh cube --name W20 --size 1 --location -4.396 2.050 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -205.00
add mesh cube --name W24 --size 1 --location -2.050 4.396 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -245.00
add mesh cube --name W25 --size 1 --location -1.255 4.685 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -255.00
add mesh cube --name W26 --size 1 --location -0.423 4.832 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -265.00
add mesh cube --name W27 --size 1 --location 0.423 4.832 0.375

set rotation 0 0 -275.00

apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -285.00
add mesh cube --name W29 --size 1 --location 2.050 4.396 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -295.00
add mesh cube --name W33 --size 1 --location 4.396 2.050 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -335.00
add mesh cube --name W34 --size 1 --location 4.685 1.255 0.465
scale 0.45 0.885 0.930
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -345.00
add mesh cube --name W35 --size 1 --location 4.832 0.423 0.375
scale 0.45 0.885 0.750
apply --scale
set rotation 0 0 -355.00
add mesh cylinder --name P45_0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location 4.090 -2.606 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P45_0c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location 4.090 -2.606 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P45_2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location 2.606 -4.090 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P45_2c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location 2.606 -4.090 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P135_0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location -2.606 -4.090 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P135_0c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location -2.606 -4.090 1.47

add mesh cylinder --name P135_2c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location -4.090 -2.606 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P225_0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location -4.090 2.606 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P225_0c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location -4.090 2.606 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P225_2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location -2.606 4.090 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P225_2c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location -2.606 4.090 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P315_0 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location 2.606 4.090 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P315_0c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location 2.606 4.090 1.47
add mesh cylinder --name P315_2 --vertices 8 --radius 0.36 --depth 1.5 --location 4.090 2.606 0.75
add mesh cylinder --name P315_2c --vertices 8 --radius 0.44 --depth 0.14 --location 4.090 2.606 1.47
select W0 W1 W2 W6 W7 W8 W9 W10 W11 W15 W16 W17 W18 W19 W20 W24 W25 W26 W27 W28 W29 W33 W34 W35 P45_0 P45_0c P45_2 P45_2c P135_0 P135_0c P135_2 P135_2c P225_0 P225_0c P225_2 P225_2c P315_0 P315_0c P315_2 P315_2c
active W0
join
rename W0 Wall
material assign Stone
select Floor Apron Under Wall
active Floor
join
rename Floor Arena
shade flat
export arena.glb
